name: Drunk
description: Generic intoxication state. Apply with [state <char> -> drunk]. Layers a tipsy/drunk affect and loose physicality onto whoever wears it; body overlays append to the character's own anatomy prose, so their canonical look is preserved underneath.

properties.affect_summary: Drunk — several drinks past where she meant to stop. Judgment loosened, inhibitions down, mood warm and unsteady; words come a beat slow and a touch too honest.
properties.mannerism_overlay: Over-corrects small movements, leans into people and furniture for balance, laughs a little too easily, loses her thread mid-sentence.

body_overlays.head: Her face is flushed warm, eyes glassy and half-lidded with a loose unfocused shine; her cheeks carry a drink-bright color.
body_overlays.legs: Her stance is unsteady, weight shifting as if the floor tilts; her steps land slightly over-corrected.
